text: Si wi'anaama heeferɓe ɓen: "Sujjanee Hinnorante On" Ɓe wi'a: "Men sujjantaa Hinnorante On, ko hommbo woni Hinnorante? Men anndaa Mo men qirritaaki Mo, kaa men sujjanay On mo yamirɗaa men sujjanngol hara menen men anndaa Mo?!" Ko o yamiri ɓe kon sujjanngol Mo ɓeydi ɓe woɗɗitagol gaayi gomɗinal Alla ngal.
